visual.name: housingCaseTimeline
visual.description: Interactive housing case management timeline visualization.

dataRoles.name: caseNumber
dataRoles.description: The case identifier used to link all records

dataRoles.name: eventType
dataRoles.description: Category of event: Hazard, MissingEpisode, AssetPlus, Intervention, Offence, Exclusion

dataRoles.name: eventLabel
dataRoles.description: Display label for the event (e.g. hazard type, intervention type, offence description)

dataRoles.name: endDate
dataRoles.description: When the event ended (blank if ongoing)

dataRoles.name: severity
dataRoles.description: Severity level or status (e.g. Significant, Moderate, Emerging for hazards)

dataRoles.name: details
dataRoles.description: Additional detail columns to show in tooltips or expanded cards

dataRoles.name: cceRisk
dataRoles.description: Child Criminal Exploitation risk level (for Contextual Risk Assessments)

dataRoles.name: cseRisk
dataRoles.description: Child Sexual Exploitation risk level (for Contextual Risk Assessments)

dataRoles.name: popcrRisk
dataRoles.description: Peer on Peer / Contextual risk level (for Contextual Risk Assessments)

dataRoles.name: syvRisk
dataRoles.description: Serious Youth Violence risk level (for Contextual Risk Assessments)

dataRoles.name: radRisk
dataRoles.description: Radicalisation risk level (for Contextual Risk Assessments)
